instruction: A candid portrait photograph in a medium close-up shot against a plain light grey wall. On the left, the woman with dark curly hair (R1) wearing a dusty pink velvet jacket stands with her body turned away, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a soft smile. On the right, the woman with straight brown hair (R3) in a blue and orange striped shirt leans her head back against R1's head, smiling widely with teeth showing as she looks upwards. They pose back-to-back with their heads touching. Soft, natural side lighting fills the frame, enhancing the warm, joyful atmosphere.

R1 looks back over her shoulder toward the camera while R3 looks upward
R1 and R3 pose back-to-back with their heads touching
R1 stands with her body turned away while maintaining the head contact pose
